cases.notes: Renault Megane Mk1 hit a tree head-on. Bumper detached, hood folded, windshield shattered, door aperture sprung -- structural.
Side impact: front door skin and fender creased, window taped over. Panel damage only, no visible structural deformation. Repairable in principle, though value is low.
Severe frontal collision, front clip destroyed, wheel displaced, glass shattered. Clear total loss on an old vehicle.
